name: eye-spa-dist
description: Capture-correctness for a built React/Vite (SPA) dist - the browserless half of the capture lane, and the React/Vite analogue of poststruct's prestruct-shapes. Checks the built output is capturable and honestly routable before any pixel is compared: exactly one app mount (#root) that the built bundle script actually targets, no un-replaced build placeholders (%VITE_*% / __VITE_*__ / the shell's placeholder title/host), one build stamp across the tree (the hashed entry bundle is the Vite analogue of prestruct's deploy-id - a partial bake leaves stale pages referencing a different bundle), and the SPA fallback shape agrees with the bake (a prerendered tree shipping /* /index.html 200 is the documented infinite-redirect loop). Zero network, zero HTML execution - attribute reads and file existence only; pixels are the pinned-browser lane's job, not this pack's.
